sitanywhere.about.description: Allows you to sit anywhere you'd like!
sitanywhere.about.explanations:
Look all the way down, quickly double tap sneak, right-click... Boom, you now sit on the block!

You can also just stand on a slab or a stair block and right-click it!
sitanywhere.uninstall.explanations:
Clicking 'Yes' will remove all scoreboards that make this datapack work on your world/server.

Players won't be able to sit down anymore unless you reload the datapack.

To ensure the datapack is properly uninstalled, disable/remove/uninstall it immediately after confirming.
sitanywhere.uninstall.message1:
Sit Anywhere has been uninstalled.

Please remove the datapack from your world to complete the uninstallation.

If you reload the world with the datapack enabled, it will recreate the scoreboards and everything will be restored.
